record.field: JavaScript: OWL components, field widget, client action
The festival opens today: show how full it is, and give the volunteers a welcome desk to check the attendees in.

field.name: description
field.p: The Festival Solidaire opens its doors today: 120 people registered for 150 seats. The organisers want to see at a glance how full the festival is, and the volunteers of the entrance need a simple screen to welcome the attendees.
The server side is ready: write the JavaScript (OWL components) of the module trivia_festival. The TODOs are in static/src/, numbered like the tasks below.

ol.li: The fill gauge (static/src/fill_gauge/, views/event_event_views.xml): a field widget festival_fill_gauge which shows the seats taken as a progress bar, green, orange then red, used on the form of the event.
The welcome desk (static/src/kiosk/, views/menus.xml): a client action festival_kiosk which lists the registrations, with a Check in button that calls the server, and a Welcome Desk menu.
Open the doors! Check 3 attendees in from your welcome desk.

field.p: ⭐ Bonus: a counter of the attendees in the systray (the icons at the top right), and a search box in the welcome desk.

💡 Odoo 20 uses OWL 3, while the documentation and the AI often show OWL 2: read the cheat sheet at the top of fill_gauge.js. A reload of the page is enough after a change of JavaScript or of an OWL template; a new record (client action, menu) needs an update of the modules (make update). Open Odoo with ?debug=assets to read the errors in the console of the browser.
